properties.requirement: how the selected version and original/archive representation determine the file returned
Identify the authorization checks and branches for the authenticated user, the requested document, and the selected version or original/archive representation

Determine whether selecting another document version or choosing original versus archive changes the resource on which authorization is evaluated, or only changes the representation or file returned after authorization

questions.reason: This question asks for evidence limits and missing facts rather than asserting a narrow authorization property.

statements.because: The request user is the principal tested before file selection.
The root document is the object passed to the owner-aware view permission check.
This selected document supplies the source or archive file returned by serve_file.
The handler returns forbidden when a non-null request user lacks owner-aware view_document permission on root_doc.
Failure of the root-document permission check returns HttpResponseForbidden before file_doc is selected.
A requested child/version ID without a version query parameter is itself the effective file document.
The returned file resource depends on request_doc, root_doc, and the version query parameter.
Archive bytes are selected only when original=true was not requested and the selected file document has an archive version.
serve_file constructs the downloadable response from file_doc and the original/archive branch.

statements.because: The selected Document passed to serve_file supplies the returned representation.
use_archive selects the archive representation branch.
The archive branch opens doc.archive_file, chooses an archive filename, and labels it application/pdf.
The non-archive branch opens doc.source_file and uses the document MIME type, with text MIME adjustments.
The selected file handle becomes a FileResponse with a Content-Disposition header and is returned.
